2. This is an application under Section 528 of BNSS preferred by the applicant for quashing the order dated 09.07.2024 treating the application under section 156(3) Cr.P.C. of O.P. No. 2 as complaint case and the order dated 18.01.2025 summoning the applicant for trial under section 376 I.P.C. including the entire proceeding of the Complaint case No. 13938 of 2024 (Ram Dulari Vs.
Sunil and others) under section 376 I.P.C. Police station Kotwali, District Fatehpur, pending in the court of Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division)/ Judicial Magistrate Court No.7, Fatehpur.

sentences.text: Allegation is that on 06.05.2024 at 09:00 in the night, the applicant herein along with other co-accused barged into the house of O.P. No.2 and with the help of rope, they had tied the hands and the legs of the husband of O.P. no.2 and the applicant herein had dragged the O.P. No.2 in the room and thereafter post-beating, committed bad act.
The said fact was also apprised to the relatives, pursuant whereto the complaint was lodged to the S.S.P. on 08.05.2024 followed by a complaint on 14.05.2024.
Post recording of the statement of the complainant under Section 200 CrPC, Dharmraj, husband of the O.P. no.2 under Section 202 CrPC followed by of Kamta son of Mohan, the Court of Addl.

Civil Judge (Jr. Div.)/ J.M., Court No.7, Fatehpur proceeded to summon the applicant under Section 376 IPC.
4.

entities.text: Civil Judge (Jr. Div.)/ J.M., Court No.7, Fatehpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Questioning the summoning order, the applicant has filed the present application.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated,
particularly in view of the fact that on 06.05.2024, the applicant was in Hyderabad in connection with a job and he seeks to rely upon certain documents which include a tabulation chart and also a certificate issued by the employer mentioning therein that the applicant was doing his duties in Hyderabad.

He further submits that with respect to a dispute of Rs.500/- with the husband of O.P.
no.2, who is also similarly placed and situated in Hyderabad, a confrontation took place, which became a motivating factor for lodging of the criminal complaint.

6. Learned A.G.A. on the other hand submits that whatever argument has been sought to be raised,
they are the matter of trial.
7. I have heard the submissions so made across the Bar and perused the record carefully.
8. In the present case in hand at the instance of the applicant challenge has been raised to the summoning order summoning the applicant under Section 376 IPC.

There are certain broad parameters which have to be adhered to in order to determine as to whether there happens to be any contradiction and variation in the statement of the witnesses, vis-a-vis the allegations contained in the complaint, so as to adjudge whether the summoning order suffers from illegality or not.

In the present case in hand, the Court finds that the pin-pointed allegations have been leveled regarding outraging the modesty of the O.P. No.2 by the applicant and so much so, in the statement under Section 200 of CrPC of the complainant, the prosecution theory has been supported and pin-pointed allegations have been leveled against the applicant.
So much so the statement under Section 200 of CrPC of husband of O.P. No.2 as well as of Kamta son of Mohan also sticks to the said allegations.
Thus, the factors itself lead to a conclusion that there is no contradiction or variation in the statement, vis-a-vis the complainant.

So far as the arguments so sought to be raised by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant was at the time when the incident took place in Hyderabad is concerned, this Court is not required to delve into the said factual issues, as the question of alibi will come at a stage, when the trial commences, which would pre-suppose leading of evidences in that regard.
The question of a fight which became a motivating factor for lodging of a complaint is concerned, the same at best is a defence, consideration whereof is not necessitated at this stage.

As regards the non-subjection of the victim for medical examination is concerned the same cannot be a sole factor to interfere with the summoning order, as its effects are to be Sunil vs State Of U.P. And Another on 2 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170955781/
2 determined and adjudged at the time when a decision is to be taken, whether the accused is to be acquitted or convicted.
